brand_vibe: Modern masculine barbershop: black cabinetry and walls, warm gold/brass pendant lighting, tan leather barber chairs, moss-green accent wall, editorial monochrome wall art. Matches the dark-v2 gold-on-near-black template almost exactly as photographed, so the palette was kept close to the exemplar default.

curation_note: Of 16 initial Booksy gallery downloads, most customer review-photos were capped at 100x100px thumbnails by Booksy (unusable, too low-res). Re-fetched the same CDN URLs with the ?size= query param stripped, which revealed full-resolution originals for 28 assets. Selected 8 final images: shop interior (hero + gallery), storefront night sign (logo/nav/gallery), a mid-cut action shot with a custom lotus fade design (experience), a client in the chair (experience), one staff studio portrait used ONLY as a small avatar (Josue Baez, tagged Master Barber Veteran on his own uniform), and 3 finished kids-fade close-ups for the gallery. Excluded: personal/casual selfies (customers and a staff group selfie), a blurry holiday-prop closeup, and all other staff studio portraits (avoided as gallery tiles per portrait rule).
